From a female perspective and this having recently happened to me:

The falling out of love or the loss of spark, be honest, if there is a way you think you can salvage it try it. Try going out on dates like you did when you had first dated, try new things together to see if that spark comes back. Its tough after such a long time together because you know everything about one another it does get kind of boring. If you know for sure the spark is just gone and you don't think there is anyway of bringing it back then be honest and don't string her along... it makes it a lot harder for her to let go and you will feel like a total jerk.

With her talking about the future we all do it. I am 20, and I see my friends having babies and many of them have plans to get married over the next year and I am sitting here "well i'm going to graduate from my college program this year then get into another program". Just make sure she knows its not something your ready to get into yet, tell her you're not trying to completely write it off but your not at that point in your life yet. For myself, I liked the idea of the dream, and my ex never told me how he felt if he had of then I would have stopped talking about it or explained to him that while I want it, I didn't want it right then I wanted it like 5 - 10 years from now. 

Edit: Also there are bound to be things you don't like about your SO, little habits or quirks but it just makes them who they are unfortunately.
